c: You walked for hours through a terrible snow storm. You met no one, and worst, found no shelter.
As you walk, the ground suddenly crumbles under your feet! Your leg violently hits a rock inside the small pit hidden under the snow. stamina(-1),add(leg:1)
Your leg hurts badly. By chance, it doesn't seem broken... You take a short break to recover.
You notice a small blood stain on your leg. Your wound seems worst than you thought, you should definitely do something about it... add(legHeal)

You find a small piece of cloth on a bush.
rsc(1)
You notice something in the snow, not too far. As you approach, you understand that it wasn't some strange rock. It's a dead body. rsc(1)
You notice a small hole in the snow on your left. You could rest here for a few minutes. stamina(1)
The wind is freezing cold. You painful adjust your coat and try to protect your face...
You notice a small animal following you cautiously... rsc(1) add(wolf)
The young wolf stays a dozen meters behind you, examining all your moves.
